course.title: Trick's Behind the Trade Application: Non-Members
course.description: Overview: Get "Behind the Trade" with me, Professional Day Trader "Trick" Mitchell, where I get struggling traders to stop doing stupid shit. If selected, I will personally coach you on not only a recent trade of your choosing, but also on the thoughts and emotions that took you into the trade. To qualify, you must agree to be on camera, and potentially answer some uncomfortable questions. This is an incredible opportunity to have your skills and emotions evaluated and guided by one of the best trading coaches you can find. I ask that you approach this opportunity with full transparency, along with a willingness to be helped, tested and pushed beyond your limits.
